name: ${localWorkspaceFolderBasename} (@@TEMPLATE_NAME@@ Sandbox)
initializeCommand: bash -c 'ready="/run/agy-sandbox/network.ready"; if [ ! -s "$ready" ]; then echo "[FAIL-CLOSED] Sandbox network isolation is NOT active! Run: sudo ./scripts/ensure-network.sh" >&2; exit 1; fi; br=$(grep "^ACTIVE_BRIDGE=" "$ready" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2); [ -z "$br" ] && br="agy0"; rules_cnt=$(ip rule show 2>/dev/null | grep -v "\[detached\]" | grep "iif ${br}" | grep -c "unreachable"); if [ "$rules_cnt" -lt 12 ]; then echo "[FAIL-CLOSED] Sandbox network isolation is NOT active! Incomplete RPDB routing rules for ${br} ($rules_cnt/12+). Run: sudo ./scripts/ensure-network.sh" >&2; exit 1; fi'
postStartCommand: rm -f /tmp/vscode-git-*.sock /tmp/vscode-ssh-auth-*.sock /tmp/user/*/vscode-git-*.sock /tmp/user/*/vscode-ssh-auth-*.sock 2>/dev/null || true; chmod 000 /tmp/vscode-wayland-*.sock /tmp/user/*/vscode-wayland-*.sock 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f /tmp/vscode-wayland-*.sock /tmp/user/*/vscode-wayland-*.sock 2>/dev/null || true; chmod 000 /home/vscode/.gnupg/S.gpg-agent* /tmp/vscode-gpg-agent* /tmp/user/*/vscode-gpg-agent* 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf /home/vscode/.gnupg/S.gpg-agent* /tmp/vscode-gpg-agent* /tmp/user/*/vscode-gpg-agent* 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f /home/vscode/.docker/config.json 2>/dev/null || true; if [ -f /home/vscode/.gitconfig ]; then _n="$(git config --file /home/vscode/.gitconfig user.name 2>/dev/null || true)"; _e="$(git config --file /home/vscode/.gitconfig user.email 2>/dev/null || true)"; _b="$(git config --file /home/vscode/.gitconfig init.defaultBranch 2>/dev/null || true)"; rm -f /home/vscode/.gitconfig; [ -n "$_n" ] && git config --file /home/vscode/.gitconfig user.name "$_n" 2>/dev/null || true; [ -n "$_e" ] && git config --file /home/vscode/.gitconfig user.email "$_e" 2>/dev/null || true; [ -n "$_b" ] && git config --file /home/vscode/.gitconfig init.defaultBranch "$_b" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
postAttachCommand: rm -f /tmp/vscode-git-*.sock /tmp/vscode-ssh-auth-*.sock /tmp/user/*/vscode-git-*.sock /tmp/user/*/vscode-ssh-auth-*.sock 2>/dev/null || true; chmod 000 /tmp/vscode-wayland-*.sock /tmp/user/*/vscode-wayland-*.sock 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f /tmp/vscode-wayland-*.sock /tmp/user/*/vscode-wayland-*.sock 2>/dev/null || true; chmod 000 /home/vscode/.gnupg/S.gpg-agent* /tmp/vscode-gpg-agent* /tmp/user/*/vscode-gpg-agent* 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf /home/vscode/.gnupg/S.gpg-agent* /tmp/vscode-gpg-agent* /tmp/user/*/vscode-gpg-agent* 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f /home/vscode/.docker/config.json 2>/dev/null || true; if [ -f /home/vscode/.gitconfig ]; then _n="$(git config --file /home/vscode/.gitconfig user.name 2>/dev/null || true)"; _e="$(git config --file /home/vscode/.gitconfig user.email 2>/dev/null || true)"; _b="$(git config --file /home/vscode/.gitconfig init.defaultBranch 2>/dev/null || true)"; rm -f /home/vscode/.gitconfig; [ -n "$_n" ] && git config --file /home/vscode/.gitconfig user.name "$_n" 2>/dev/null || true; [ -n "$_e" ] && git config --file /home/vscode/.gitconfig user.email "$_e" 2>/dev/null || true; [ -n "$_b" ] && git config --file /home/vscode/.gitconfig init.defaultBranch "$_b" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
